body:
Text matching currently joins text on either side of an inline image or footnote reference, producing edit ranges that include—and could delete—the native element. Split replacement-search segments at non-text inline elements, with offline regressions that fail on `main` for both cases. Non-destructive comment and image-insertion anchors explicitly retain cross-element matching, including typography folding.

Add three small anonymous API-shaped fixtures (9 KB total) covering image identity/UTF-16 position, a positioned drawing, footnote reference/body scoping, and a rich sibling tab versus a blank selected tab. Assertions cover semantic ranges, object metadata and tab ownership; no raw JSON snapshot comparisons or live API calls. This is based directly on `origin/main` and is independently mergeable, with no dependency on the separate lossy-write-guard branch.

**Provenance:** these are safely constructed synthetic equivalents using Google's public Docs v1 schema and upstream synthetic tests, not newly collected live responses or copied private captures. The fixtures explicitly record that limitation. No private campaign files, document IDs, accounts, comments, URLs, names or transient content URIs were imported into the payloads.

**Supersession:** every fixture records its local schema/version and API-shape/request metadata. A closed-vocabulary v1 loader passes validated payloads through unchanged and rejects unknown fields, types and versions with a path and link to the documented procedure. Add a successor file and explicit loader support when a shape changes; retain old fixtures while their shapes remain supported, and remove them only when that support is removed. Nothing silently skips or auto-updates.

Validation:
- 127 focused caller/API tests passed; the two native-boundary assertions were first observed failing against unchanged `main`.
- Full suite: 1,577 passed.
- `uv run ruff check gdoc/api/docs.py tests/test_api_captures.py`: passed.
- Repository-wide `uv run ruff check gdoc/ tests/`: 196 findings with the same file/code/message counts as `origin/main`; no new diagnostics.
- `bash scripts/check-no-stubs.sh`: passed.

`REPLICATE.md` records the substantive commit in a separate metadata-only follow-up commit.
title: Protect native edit boundaries with versioned offline API fixtures
